summary: Foli was a Nomai from the Vessel who went missing after the Vessel crashed on Dark Bramble. Foli's partner Kousa escaped on Escape Pod 1 to Brittle Hollow and never learned what happened to Foli.

location: Foli was last on the Vessel before it crashed on Dark Bramble.
Foli's fate after the Vessel crash is unknown.
lore: Foli was a Nomai from Escall's Vessel.
Foli was the romantic partner of Kousa.
Kousa wondered whether Foli was still alive after escaping to Brittle Hollow on Escape Pod 1.
Kousa wrote: 'I am unsure how to survive in this place without you' and 'I am unsure how to be me without you' about Foli.
